title: Patching LG G Watch W100 care pack, now stuck on boot
symptom: After installing the care pack for LG G Watch W100 (build M1D65S), patching throws an error and the watch shows the LG boot screen forever. Manual patching with xdelta3 gives a checksum error; adding no-checksum option applies the patch but the watch still hangs at boot image.
evidence_quote: I installed the care pack for my G Watch (build M1D65S). Patching ~~worked without any problems but~~ throws an error and now it just shows the LG boot screen forever.
